vb_textbox.text: I don't feel that the height of the gnome has much importance but I feel it is something to do with their hats, and if the hat is longer than the gnomes body he gets more mushrooms.My first piece of advice is to experiment yourself first and see if any of the gnomes give you more mushrooms than others. For me red on the left gave me most mushrooms but I feel that the game maybe gets wise to which gnome you pick most often because when I chose red several times in a row the mushrooms started getting less. The green guy gave me more than the brown one but then this sometimes switched so maybe whether they were on the left or the right is important. I also found that if I chose a gnome I had not chosen recently, I got more mushrooms. I don't know if any of my assumptions are correct but I wish you the best of luck!!
